caption:
He grew up the son of a cobbler in rural Maharashtra. Today, his company has over 4,500 employees.

Ashok Khade started as an apprentice draftsman at Mazagon Dock, then worked in West Germany on a submarine engineering project. He came back and co-founded DAS Offshore Engineering with his brothers in the early-to-mid 1990s - building an offshore engineering company from a Dalit family with no business background. In 2026, he was awarded the Padma Shri, one of India's highest civilian honors.

The starting point doesn't set the ceiling. It just sets how far someone has to travel to get there.
